description: Wire the comments and centralized notifications subsystems into the Dart client end-to-end against the FEAT-002 schema, meeting the founder's Definition of Done (works, invalid input, loading, error, empty states, permissions, no private-data exposure, tested, integrates cleanly). This turns the two load-bearing subsystems from schema into functioning, verifiable vertical slices. Notifications move off MockData onto the real `notifications` table (with mock fallback preserved for offline/tests); comments become a first-class model + repository + UI. Both remain verifiable via analyze+test on the mock path; live behavior against Supabase is a documented environment risk.
steps: COMMENTS MODEL: add lib/models/comment.dart — immutable Comment {id, postId, author (UserProfile), parentId?, content, likeCount, createdAt} with copyWith + id-based ==/hashCode, matching the style of post.dart.

COMMENTS REPOSITORY: add lib/data/comment_repository.dart as a ChangeNotifier following the exact repository pattern (synchronous getters over an in-memory cache seeded from mock data, guarded fire-and-forget load/persist, single notify per mutation). Methods: commentsFor(postId) (newest-or-threaded order), addComment(postId, content, {parentId}) with client-side validation (non-empty, <=2000 chars) AND relying on the server check constraint as the source of truth, and a guarded _persist that inserts into the `comments` table with a client-generated UUID (newUuidV4). Add mock seed comments to mock_data.dart so the UI/tests have data.

COMMENTS UI: replace the 'Replies are not available in this demo' snackbar in home_feed_screen.dart (and the PostCard reply action) with a real comments screen lib/screens/comments_screen.dart: shows the parent post, a list of comments (loading state, empty state 'No comments yet', error state), and a composer with the character counter + validation. Follow the existing screen/theme conventions (AnimatedBuilder on the repo, AppColors/AppTextStyles). Ensure private-data safety: only render comments the repository provides (which server-side RLS from FEAT-002 already scopes to viewable posts).

NOTIFICATIONS ON REAL TABLE: extend ProfileRepository (or add a dedicated NotificationRepository if cleaner — decide based on cohesion and note the decision) so notifications() / unreadNotifications / markNotificationsRead read from the `notifications` table instead of MockData, KEEPING the guarded mock fallback so offline/tests still work. Map the notifications row (recipient/actor/type/entity/preview/read/created_at) to the existing NotificationItem model, extending NotificationItem/NotificationType if needed to cover 'follow_request' and 'system' types added in FEAT-002. markNotificationsRead must persist `read=true` to the table (guarded) as well as updating memory. Preserve the existing profile_repository_test.dart assertions or adapt them intentionally with documented reasons.

NOTIFICATIONS UI: update notifications_screen.dart to render the new types (follow_request, system) with sensible icons/labels and correct empty/loading/error states. Keep unread highlighting + 'Mark all read'.

TESTS: add test/comment_repository_test.dart (validation rejects empty/over-long content; addComment prepends/orders correctly and notifies once; commentsFor filters by postId; unknown post returns empty) and extend the notification tests for the new types + markNotificationsRead persistence path (mock fallback). All tests pure, no Supabase boot. Keep existing tests green.
acceptance_criteria: lib/models/comment.dart, lib/data/comment_repository.dart, and lib/screens/comments_screen.dart exist and integrate with the feed (reply action opens comments, not a snackbar)

addComment validates content client-side (non-empty, <=2000) and persists via a guarded insert into the comments table with a client UUID; empty/loading/error/empty-list states are all handled in the UI
Notifications read from the `notifications` table with a preserved MockData fallback; NotificationType covers the FEAT-002 types; markNotificationsRead persists read state (guarded)
New unit tests for comments (incl. validation) and notifications pass; existing tests remain green
`flutter analyze` reports 'No issues found!' and `flutter test` passes
verification: export HOME=/tmp/fakehome PATH="/opt/flutter/bin:$PATH" PUB_CACHE=/opt/pub-cache && flutter analyze && flutter test
Confirm the reply action in home_feed_screen.dart/post_card no longer shows the 'not available in this demo' snackbar and routes to comments_screen.dart
findings: Implemented the comments + centralized notifications vertical slices against the FEAT-002 schema. NEW: lib/models/comment.dart (immutable Comment {id, postId, author, parentId?, content, likeCount, createdAt} with copyWith + id-based ==/hashCode, matching post.dart); lib/data/comment_repository.dart (ChangeNotifier singleton over an in-memory cache seeded from MockData.comments(), guarded fire-and-forget load() joining profiles(*), commentsFor(postId) newest-first + unmodifiable + empty for unknown post, addComment(postId, content, {parentId}) with client-side validation via CommentValidationError (non-empty after trim, <=2000 chars mirroring the server check as source of truth) that inserts with a client newUuidV4() id into the `comments` table via a guarded _persistComment; the client never writes server-owned reply_count/like_count); lib/screens/comments_screen.dart (parent PostCard header, comments list with empty 'No comments yet' state, composer with live char counter + inline validation error; only renders repository/RLS-provided comments). CHANGED: home_feed_screen.dart reply action (and post tap) now push CommentsScreen instead of the 'Replies are not available in this demo' snackbar. NotificationType extended with followRequest + system (the two FEAT-002 types); mock_data.dart adds comments() seed + follow_request/system notification samples. NOTIFICATIONS DECISION: kept on ProfileRepository rather than a dedicated NotificationRepository - notifications are read-only-plus-mark-read (clients never insert; SECURITY DEFINER triggers produce them), they reuse the actor UserProfile mapping this repo already owns, and profile_repository_test.dart asserts this surface; a separate singleton would add lifecycle overhead for a small, tightly-coupled surface. ProfileRepository now has loadNotifications() (guarded, recipient-scoped, joins actor via profiles!notifications_actor_fkey, newest-first, mock fallback preserved), _notificationFromRow mapping recipient/actor/type/entity/preview/read/created_at with snake_case follow_request handling and unknown->system fallback, and markNotificationsRead() that is idempotent (only notifies/persists when something changed) and persists read=true to the table via guarded _persistNotificationsRead. notifications_screen.dart renders icons/labels for the new types and adds an empty state; unread highlight + 'Mark all read' preserved. TESTS: added test/comment_repository_test.dart (15 tests: filter-by-postId, newest-first, unmodifiable, unknown->empty, validation rejects empty/whitespace/over-long + accepts exactly max, no-mutate/no-notify on invalid, prepend/order, trim, notifies once, parentId, current-user author, no cross-post leak) and extended profile_repository_test.dart (guarded mark-read idempotence on mock fallback, follow_request/system type coverage, 7-value enum check). VERIFICATION: `flutter analyze` => 8 issues found (all pre-existing baseline INFO lints inherited from main: withOpacity/prefer_const/dangling-doc/anonKey), exit 0, no NEW issues introduced (one prefer_const info I introduced was fixed). `flutter test` => 58/58 All tests passed (40 baseline + 18 new). analysis_options.yaml exclude-block tooling side-effect reverted, not committed. ENVIRONMENT RISK: no reachable/administerable Supabase project and no service-role key here, so live behavior of the notifications/comments tables, the SECURITY DEFINER notification triggers, the reply_count sync trigger, and RLS visibility scoping is UNVERIFIED - validated only by structural review of migration 0002 and exercised via the MockData fallback path; live application remains a documented environment risk. REVIEW PASS v1 (addressing 2026-09-08-112626-review.md): (Issue 4 JUSTIFIED) can_view_profile reentrancy through the RLS-protected profiles/follows tables cannot be executed here — it requires a live Postgres to confirm the SECURITY DEFINER definer-rights reads bypass caller RLS rather than recurse/produce bad plans. No reachable/administerable Supabase project or service-role key in this sandbox, so this stays a structural-review-only observation and a documented environment risk (unchanged; also recorded on the RLS side in FEAT-002). (Issue 5 JUSTIFIED/TRACKED) the client follow-request/is_private contract (setting follows.status='pending' and respecting is_private when the client writes follows) is intentionally a LATER roadmap phase — task.json roadmap_future_phases.phase_2_privacy_safety_client explicitly owns 'follow-request accept/deny flow' and the private-account toggle; no lib/ code writes follows in Phase 1, so no accepted-vs-pending regression can occur yet. Confirmed tracked; no change needed in this phase. (Issue 6 FIXED via new migration) notify_on_follow (0002) was insert-only, so a pending->accepted acceptance produced no notification to the requester. Added supabase/migrations/0003_follow_accept_notification.sql (NEW file; 0001/0002 untouched): an idempotent `after update of status` trigger notify_on_follow_accepted() that emits exactly one 'follow' notification to the original follower on the pending->accepted transition (guarded by old.status is distinct from 'accepted' so no-op updates never double-notify), mirroring the 0002 producers' SECURITY DEFINER + set search_path + self-notify + is_blocked guards; no service_role keys. Like all SQL here it is verified by structural review only (same environment risk as issues 3/4). VERIFICATION after review pass: flutter analyze => 8 baseline INFO lints only; flutter test => 64/64 pass.
